# Data pack manifests

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

The package identity of a data pack, and the part of a style manifest the build checks.

<a id="pack"></a>

## `pack.yaml`

The package identity of an Entity Pack or a Presentation Pack, at the root of its directory.

`pack.yaml`, exactly: any other field is refused, `dependencies` included until a world's requirements are resolved, so no field is accepted that nothing checks.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authors` | list of text | yes | — | — | Who made the pack: at least one name. |
| `id` | [PackId](#pack-packid) | yes | — | — | The pack's id; a world names it in `requires:`, and it must equal the pack directory's name. |
| `license` | [License](#pack-license) | yes | — | — | The pack's licence, an SPDX expression; the world's licence policy must allow it. |
| `mineworld` | [Compatibility](#pack-compatibility) | yes | — | — | The framework versions the pack works with, a semver range such as "^0.1". |
| `repository` | text | no | `null` | — | Where the pack's source lives, a URL. |
| `type` | [PackType](#pack-packtype) | yes | — | — | What kind of pack this file identifies: presentation-pack or entity-pack. |
| `version` | [Version](#pack-version) | yes | — | — | The pack's release version, semver. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
authors:
  - Ana Lee
id: seaside-goods
license: MIT
mineworld: "^0.1"
type: entity-pack
version: "0.1.0"
```

### Types used above

<a id="pack-compatibility"></a>

#### `Compatibility`

A semver range with Cargo's meaning, such as "^0.1" (0.1.x and nothing else). Quote it in YAML.

**Type:** text.

<a id="pack-license"></a>

#### `License`

An SPDX licence expression, such as MIT or MIT OR Apache-2.0, checked against the SPDX licence list.

**Type:** text.

<a id="pack-packid"></a>

#### `PackId`

A pack's id, such as modern-goods: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, beginning with a letter, with no -- and no trailing -.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z]([a-z0-9]|-[a-z0-9])*$`.

<a id="pack-packtype"></a>

#### `PackType`

What kind of pack this is. A pack.yaml identifies a presentation-pack or an entity-pack; the other kinds have their own carriers.

**Type:** one of `system-pack`, `controller-pack`, `world-pack`, `presentation-pack`, `entity-pack`.

<a id="pack-version"></a>

#### `Version`

A semver version, such as 0.1.0.

**Type:** text.

<a id="style"></a>

## `manifest.yaml` (a style manifest)

The fields of a Presentation Pack's style manifest that `mineworld packs validate` checks. Its other keys are the art direction's (`docs/ART_DIRECTION.md` §12).

What `mineworld packs` needs of a style manifest; the rest of its schema is `ART_DIRECTION.md`'s, so other fields are not this crate's to refuse.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dimension` | list of text | yes | — | — | The dimensions the style draws in, such as [3d]: at least one. The manifest's other keys are the art direction's (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md §12) and are not checked here. |
| `id` | text | yes | — | — | The style's id. |

Example:

```yaml
dimension:
  - "2d"
  - "3d"
id: cosy-town
```
